claims.evidence_quote: For schools across Missouri and the nation, E-Rate helps ensure that students, regardless of their zip code or family income, have access to the connectivity they need to succeed. Eliminating or significantly reducing E-Rate funding would place an unnecessary burden on school districts and widen the digital divide, particularly for rural and high-poverty communities.
